what: Where Tom can sit (his order of 25 October, item 2: "Tom sits down in the game as played"). Street metres as every spec: x along Quay Street, y up, z back from the pavement. Each seat is a slot: the point on the floor under the sitter's seat bone, and the way the sitter faces (toward face_x, face_z). The sit itself is Epic's Game Animation Sample's bench interaction (approach clips from five sides on either foot, an idle loop, a stand-up), warped onto the slot (SliceCharacter.cpp, TryStartSit).
source: The office's fixed wall bench: production/specs/mickeys-office.json box 'bench' (x 8.14 to 8.65, z 5.65 to 7.26); its three seats 0.535 m apart along z (tools/art-recipes/mickeys-props/bench.py: 1.60 m, three cushions, seat 0.451 m, the sample's bench 0.43 m); the slot 0.30 m behind the seat's front edge, as the sample's bench (its slot 0.31 m behind the front); facing into the room, as Ron's mark on it (face_x 6.0).

room.why: Where he must stand for E to sit him: the office's public side, from the stair strip's wall to the side wall and from the shop front to the counter (mickeys-office.json boxes). A seat is never offered through a wall or the window. (The first try traced a line to the seat, and a static mesh of the room stopped it.)
